Lines before the first snippet are not assembled.

Sections start with `.p2align 2`, llvm-mc's default alignment for ARM code;
see mips.txt.

=== branches into another section
        .text
        .p2align 2
entry:
        bl      helper
        b       helper
        beq     helper
        .section .text.helper, "ax"
        .p2align 2
helper:
        b       entry

=== data across sections
        .text
        .p2align 2
entry:
        bx      lr
        .data
        .p2align 2
        .word   entry
        .word   entry - .
